Record Class SqlDialectOptions

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.data.model.query.builder.sql.SqlDialectOptions
Record Components:
dialect - The dialect these options apply to.
compatibility - A named compatibility level.
@Internal public record SqlDialectOptions(Dialect dialect, Optional<String> compatibility) extends Record
Resolved SQL dialect options used during SQL generation and runtime binding.
